QF.id: VIII Introduction to Clearing and Settlement System_36

question.text: Market-Wide Position Limits (MWPL) for equity derivatives apply to:

answer.text: Futures and options contracts on individual securities; index derivatives are governed by separate index futures/options position-limit rules
Both index and stock derivatives, set uniformly at 20% of total open interest
Index derivatives only, set at 15% of the free-float market capitalisation
All exchange-traded derivatives, capped at 1 million contracts

explanation.text: The Logic: The MWPL framework is specified by SEBI/exchanges for futures and options contracts on individual securities. Index futures and index options are not governed by MWPL; instead, they have their own separate client-level, PAN-level and trading-member-level position-limit rules. The Trap: Do not assume MWPL applies to index derivatives - the position-limit regime for indices is a different set of rules from the stock-level MWPL framework. Note: Source: NISM-Series-VIII workbook (Dec 2025), pages 167-169.
